request.description: Borrower only. Creates a booking request and returns 201. Set start_date and end_date to future Manila local times and equipment_id to the ID of an existing available item; invalid dates, unavailable equipment, or overlap with an approved booking return 422. Missing or invalid bearer token returns 401; a signed-in role without access returns 403.

Requires a valid token. The booking owner, admins, and sysadmins receive it with 200; other users receive 403. Set booking_id to the intended existing record; never assume an ID. Missing or invalid bearer token returns 401.
Borrower or admin. Downloads the official borrowing slip PDF containing ticket ID and equipment details.

Admin or sysadmin only. Approves a pending booking and returns 200; invalid state, expired dates, maintenance, or overlapping bookings return 422. The saved assertion expects the documented success status; if you choose a commented error example, update the expected status. Set booking_id to the intended existing record; never assume an ID. Missing or invalid bearer token returns 401; a signed-in role without access returns 403.

Admin or sysadmin only. Queues a reminder for an approved booking and returns 200; inactive bookings return 422. Set booking_id to the intended existing record; never assume an ID. Missing or invalid bearer token returns 401; a signed-in role without access returns 403.

Admin or sysadmin only. Marks an approved booking as returned and returns 200; inactive bookings return 422. Set booking_id to the intended existing record; never assume an ID. Missing or invalid bearer token returns 401; a signed-in role without access returns 403.

Admin or sysadmin only. Rejects a pending or approved booking and returns 200; other statuses return 422. The saved assertion expects the documented success status; if you choose a commented error example, update the expected status. Set booking_id to the intended existing record; never assume an ID. Missing or invalid bearer token returns 401; a signed-in role without access returns 403.

The booking owner, admins, and sysadmins can cancel a pending or approved booking; returns 200 on success. Set booking_id to the intended existing record; never assume an ID. Missing or invalid bearer token returns 401; a user without permission returns 403.

Borrower only, and only for their own booking. Marks it read and returns 200. Set booking_id to the intended existing record; never assume an ID. Missing or invalid bearer token returns 401; non-borrowers or other users receive 403.
